| # | Action | What happens | Why it matters |
|---|--------|--------------|----------------|

| 3 | **Start the engine** | The electric motor receives power and begins operating. | Powers the drivetrain, HVAC, infotainment, and other systems. |
| 4 | **Release the brake pedal** *(optional)* | The brake is disengaged, allowing the car to move freely. | You’ll only do this once you’re ready to drive. |
